notes.title: Last discount
notes.content: This discount is the last discount for this game, so the discount amount has reached Steam's upper limit of 93%. After this discount, the game will not be discounted again.

notes.title: "Love In The Dark" will be turned into a free game.
notes.content:
Dear players:
Hello everyone!
Firstly, we are extremely grateful to each and every player for your support and love for the game "Love in the Night". It is your enthusiasm that has enabled this game to have an extraordinarily lively period.
However, recently we have had to face a realistic situation, that is, the number of players of the game has been gradually decreasing. This has directly led to the players who have purchased the game encountering great difficulties when matching teammates to play the game. In many cases, it's hard to gather enough people to start a pleasant gaming experience, which also goes against our original intention of hoping that everyone can have a great time playing in the game.
In order to improve this situation and allow more players to easily join the game and enjoy the fun of "Love in the Night" together with everyone, after careful consideration, we have decided to make a major adjustment: One week after this announcement is issued, we will turn the game "Love in the Night" into a free game.
Here, we would like to especially remind all players that within the next week, please don't purchase the game for now to avoid unnecessary losses.
Meanwhile, we also deeply understand that for the players who have already purchased the game, you have put your sincere feelings and enthusiasm into it and also paid the actual fees. Therefore, after it becomes free, you will receive double compensation.
Finally, once again, we would like to thank every player for your support for "Love in the Night". We hope that after the game becomes free, more players can join in, making our "Love in the Night" lively again and enabling everyone to have a pleasant experience in the game!
The Operation Team of "Love in the Night"
December 24, 2024

notes.title: 游戏内语音现已上线 In game voice is now online
notes.content:
现在游戏内语音默认打开，按V切换打开关闭。如果不喜欢语音可以在游戏设置多人语音里面永久关闭。如果有任何问题请通过QQ群和我们联系。
The voice in the game is now on by default, press V to switch on and off. If you don't like voice, you can permanently turn it off in the game settings for multiplayer voice. If you have any questions, please contact us through QQ group.
